tools.name: list_registry_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List the names of the Ouro UI registry items, in registry order. Pass filter to keep only the names that contain it, such as 'dialog' or 'button'. Use a name from this list with get_item_install or get_item_docs.

filter.description: Keep only the items whose name contains this text, ignoring case.

names.description: The names of the matching registry items, in registry order, separated by commas.

tools.name: get_item_install
tools.title: Install command
tools.description: Return the shadcn command that adds one registry item to an app, pinned to the newest Ouro UI release. Run the command as it is; it installs the item and the Ouro items it needs. The name is one from list_registry_items.

name.description: The registry item's name, such as dialog.

command.description: The command that adds the item, pinned to a release.

release.description: The release tag the command pins, such as v1.3.204.

tools.name: get_item_docs
tools.title: Item docs
tools.description: Return the docs page address for one registry item and, when the docs are in the repository, the page's Markdown: its purpose, props, examples and when to use something else. The name is one from list_registry_items.

name.description: The registry item's name, such as dialog.

url.description: The item's docs page on the Ouro UI site.

markdown.description: The item's docs in Markdown, or an empty string when the repository has none for it.
